tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather conditions for a specified location. Returns temperature, humidity, wind speed, and a short conditions summary.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Use this to find information, articles, or URLs on any topic. Search the web for information on a given query. Returns a ranked list of URLs with titles and short excerpts.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the text contents of a file at a specified path on the local filesystem.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email to a recipient with a specified subject and body text.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create a new event on the user's calendar with a title, date, start time, and optional description.
